## Overview

**Cambodian Motorcycle Consumer Analysis** — part of the [Data Science Projects Collection](https://github.com/PaulChanCyber/Data-Science-Project-). Segmentation and brand/price analysis in Cambodia's motorcycle market.

## Background & Motivation

Consumer behavior study in the **Cambodian motorcycle market** (PDS collection). Focus on segmentation rather than single-price prediction.

Motorcycles dominate urban mobility in Cambodia; brands and dealers need evidence on how consumers trade off price, engine size, and brand loyalty.

## Project Guidelines & Objectives

- Collect listing or survey-style market data on brands, specs, and prices
- Segment consumers/SKUs by price band and brand share
- Visualize market structure (bar/box plots, heatmaps)
- Summarize implications for inventory and marketing

## Data Collection & Preparation

Scraped motorcycle listing data from Cambodian classified/marketplace sources.

## Methodology & Analysis

EDA, segmentation, brand share analysis, price distribution by specification tier.

## Model Evaluation

Descriptive and comparative metrics; segment stability across price quantiles.

## Results & Key Learnings

Market structure report supporting dealer positioning and PDS consumer-analytics learning outcomes.
